name: blender-node-skills
description: Teach AI agents to build Blender Geometry Nodes graphs correctly, with teaching annotations you can learn from.

interface.shortDescription: Build and explain Blender Geometry Nodes graphs with live introspection.
interface.longDescription: Packages the shipped Geometry Nodes skill and a blender-mcp stdio entry. The skill remains the only build, edit, and explain loop: live node and socket introspection, result verification, and teaching frames. Codex discovers the shared skills directory and launches blender-mcp from PATH.
defaultPrompt: Read the Blender version and the current Geometry Nodes graph.
Explain the current Geometry Nodes graph without changing it.
Build a small Geometry Nodes graph I can check in Blender.
